speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have had a fever and altered mental status for two days; to help me determine the cause, please describe your specific symptoms, any recent travel or animal exposure, and your medical history.

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)

The patient's history of tics and current use of haloperidol, combined with fever and altered mentation, strongly suggests Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome. I will now request specific lab results to confirm muscle rigidity and rule out other causes. REQUEST TEST: CBC, CMP (including CK), and Liver Function Tests.
